simple: Trains employees to recognize phishing using examples of attacks that really reach your company: generative AI creates simulated phishing emails based on real attacks that Harmony Email has stopped — from QR codes and fake emails from executives (BEC) to internal mailings. You can set the attack type and sender, prioritize training for the most-attacked departments and people, and automatically send extra materials from a library of training modules and videos to those who “fall for it”. A separate add-on to Harmony Email & Collaboration; simulations work for Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online) mailboxes.
